mapper.sql: b.id, b.title, b.author, b.description, b.chapter_count, b.scope, b.owner_id, b.owner_nickname, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.status, b.share_token, b.share_token_expires_at, b.storage_key, b.source_filename, b.file_size, b.sha256, b.version, b.created_at, b.updated_at
FROM reader_book b LEFT JOIN reader_category c ON c.id = b.category_id
AND (LOWER(b.title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%') OR LOWER(b.author) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(TRIM(#{keyword})), '%'))
